title: Sleeps 24! 3 Modern 4BDR Townhomes | Group Retreat
description:
- 3 neighboring townhomes, sleeps 24 total guests
- Beautiful, newly built townhomes with chic design
- Modern, fully equipped kitchens
- 4 bedrooms in each, curated with a stylish, southern-inspired flair
- Covered balconies with lounge seating areas

The space
Welcome to Lischey, 98 Degrees, & The Stage! These three townhomes are right next to each other, with a total of 12 bedrooms, sleeping 24 guests—an ideal option for groups looking to spread out.

These newly built and stunning 3-story retreats are as lively and inviting as Nashville itself, combining modern design with Southern-inspired style. 

As you step inside each townhome, the bright and open living spaces greet you with chic design. Kick back and relax on the plush sectionals after a day of Nashville adventures. The large, modern kitchens feature an island with barstool seats, stainless steel appliances, and sleek finishes. For those balancing work and play, each home includes a desk vanity—ideal for catching up on emails or getting your glam on before a night out on the town.

Each townhome offers four bedrooms, curated with a touch of Southern flair. The primary suites are a private retreat, each featuring a king bed, TV, and an ensuite bathroom. On the second floors, you’ll find two equally charming bedrooms—one with a king bed and the other with a queen bed. Both bedrooms have a TV and share a hallway bathroom. The fourth bedrooms offer a built-in bunk bed and its own ensuite bathroom, providing flexible sleeping arrangements.

The living space continues outside on the covered balconies, where lounge seating areas await. Whether you’re starting your day with coffee or ending it with a craft cocktail, these spaces are made for relaxing all day long.

Book Lischey, 98 Degrees, & The Stage, the perfect home base for your next Music City getaway!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we’re at your fingertips!

East Nashville is one of Nashville's oldest neighborhoods, located just across the Cumberland River. Known for its eclectic and artsy atmosphere, you'll find some of the city's best restaurants, live music venues, shopping, and easy access to Nissan Stadium. Bonus: all of the excitement of Broadway is just a 10-minute Uber drive away. Don't be surprised if you see one of your favorite musicians walking around this neighborhood, as many of them call it home!

Experience Nashville, AvantStay style.
